title: Pager memory classification and page reference observation

scope.rationale: sqlite3PagerMemUsed approximates Pager plus PCache allocation bytes, sqlite3PagerIsMemdb classifies temporary-file and mem-VFS-backed pagers as memory databases, and sqlite3PagerPageRefcount exposes the live page-cache reference count.

external_source_responsibilities: Pager opening owns the cache, file handle allocation, names, extra-byte width, and page-size state
Page cache owns and updates the reference count
Pager construction sets temporary and memory-VFS identities
dependencies.caller_closure: All three observation helpers are assigned; live database-status traversal consumes Pager memory usage and tests exercise Pager/cache owners.

outputs: Approximate owned bytes, memory-backed boolean, or live reference count
contracts.state_and_results: Memory usage includes a modeled per-page size times current cache pages, Pager/cache/file/name owner bytes, and one page-sized temporary buffer. Memory classification is temporary OR memory_vfs. Reference result is the exact cache-page references field.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns synchronization; cache page counting enters its group lock; no callbacks or I/O.

representation_differences: Zig Pager, Cache, VFS file storage, and names are separate allocations rather than one sqlite3MallocSize-visible allocation, so memoryUsed sums those owner sizes while preserving the source per-page formula and extra page-sized temporary allocation.
Zig returns usize and bool instead of C int. Temporary and memVfs fields are named temporary and memory_vfs.

oracle.protocol: Open a live 4,096-byte Pager with 24 extra bytes, compare the owner-only memory estimate against its owned structures, fetch one page, and require exactly one modeled per-page increment; also observe reference count 1 on a fetched internal page and classify ordinary false, memory-VFS true, and temporary true states.
internal_observations: Pager page size, cache extra size, cache page count, and returned approximate bytes
oracle.normalization: Booleans normalize to zero/nonzero and counts compare exactly.

assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; memory usage obtains the cache count under its group lock and other observations rely on caller synchronization.

integration.production_owner: src/core/pager.zig runtime Pager and PCache owner plus src/core/internal/pager_core.zig source-state owner
integration.native_call_path: sqlite3_db_status64 CACHE_USED/CACHE_USED_SHARED traverses every main and attached runtime Pager and consumes Pager.memoryUsed; temporary opening and fetched-page owners expose the other observations.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Add pinned-C temp/mem-VFS, Pager-memory, and page-reference differential.
